_about: Adopted budget figures, copied from the City of Portland's adopted budget pages and budget books. Every number cites its source; don't add figures without one.

headline._source: Adopted budget page: '$8.55 billion total budget', '$4.48 billion in program expenses', '$803.4 million in General Fund discretionary'.

service_areas._source: Adopted budget pages (FY 2025-26 and FY 2026-27): descriptions quoted or closely paraphrased from the City's own text.
service_areas.Public Works: Includes the Water Bureau, the Bureau of Environmental Services, the Portland Bureau of Transportation, and Portland Parks & Recreation. Includes capital projects, not just operations.
service_areas.Public Safety: Includes the Portland Police Bureau and Portland Fire & Rescue.
service_areas.City Administrator: Includes Fund and Debt Management: pass-through funds such as debt proceeds, General Fund contingency, and technical accounts.
